description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), grants [Last Stand] and [Stoneskin: 30%], grants [Awoken Guardian] and [High Quick Cast] for 15 seconds to the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Stoneskin: 30%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 30% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Awoken Guardian
description.text: White Magic abilities don't consume uses and single target heals grant [Stoneskin: 30/40/50/60/70%] to target at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time
